Deep Void Extraction.name: Deep Void Extraction
Deep Void Extraction.description: The user goes where no stretcher fits, such as a flooded basement, a burning floor or a crawlspace under a failing slab, then straps the victim into a harness and hauls them out by rope. The user can reach and bring out a trapped person anywhere their own body fits, and the victim takes no further injury on the way out, though the user still faces the fire, water and debris. Stamina: extreme.
